newsitem.title: HONDURAS: Honduras hopes to get $250 mln from IMF.
newsitem.headline: Honduras hopes to get $250 mln from IMF.

text.p: Honduras hopes to receive about $250 million in credits from the International Monetary Fund in 1997 after signing in February a new letter of intent, central bank President Hugo Pino said.
"Achieving an accord with the IMF in February will allow us access to $250 million in 1997," Pino told reporters.
Honduras failed to reach such an agreement with the IMF for 1996.
Pino said the funds would be used for balance of payments support and projects in different sectors of the economy.
Honduras expects a fiscal deficit of 2.5 percent of GDP in 1997, down from an expected 3.5 percent this year.
